hookText: 1Password was breached through an employee's GitHub account

beats.say: On November 19, 1Password found signs that an attacker had entered an employee's corporate GitHub account.
The attacker used it to reach source code and push malicious code to backend services, which downloaded customer names, email addresses, and internal account metadata.
Customer vault contents were never accessed, and 1Password says its design means a breach of its systems cannot expose vault contents.
